turns.text: Hi, this is Amazon fraud prevention. Someone attempted to buy 700 dollars of electronics using your account.
That can't be right, I haven't ordered anything.
We must verify you are the account holder. Stay on the line, do not call Amazon support, I will handle everything.
Purchase a 500 dollar gift card now and read me the numbers to restore your account before it is closed today.
Okay, I will go buy one right now.
Great. Read me the gift card code now so I can complete the verification.
